summary: The trusted live-process constrained-HTTP compiler and pinned-HTTPS transport validate and reserve all normal fallible transport-local work before authority issuance, bind the exact reservation into the signed lease, and consume it once before network dispatch.
boundaries: The frozen claim applies only to the trusted live-process compiler and genuine authority-enforced pinned-HTTPS transport route.
Reservations and transport-rate capacity are process-local; restart-durable retirement and replacement of issued-but-unconsumed lease generations remain CF-060.
An authority rejection after issuance but before durable consumption produces zero network activity but can still strand the issued lease.
The proof is one local fictional constrained-HTTP route, not customer, production, real-provider, hostile-administrator, arbitrary-API, public, or general transport evidence.
freezeRule: Any change to a listed file requires a new checkpoint and regenerated hashes.
